note: Literature confirms brain iron accumulation in GTPBP2 deficiency is an age-dependent, later-onset finding seen in only a small subset of older individuals.

evidence.text: A literature review noted that out of 28 individuals with Jaberi-Elahi syndrome, all four patients with brain iron accumulation were older individuals aged between 19 and 30 years.

evidence.text: Clinical delineation of GTPBP2 deficiency indicates that phenotypic manifestations are age-related, and brain iron accumulation may appear only after childhood.
